name: MetalMare
introduce:
KX-084 MetalMare
A heavy assault ST developed by Kamadar.
Equipped with an SAT-1 gas guidance system made from Arashium alloy, it converts a portion of the engine's power into kinetic energy for the firearm, enhancing the lethality of each shot. With a simple, stable design, it serves as an NDF-certified mobile turret.

10024.name: Pressurizer
10024.SpecificEffects: When attacking with an Assault Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>70%</color> chance to trigger: DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

30042.name: Matching Mod
30042.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, if the target cannot retaliate, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-4%</color>.
